column4: Reads the called name and arguments off an unparsed tools/call for the refusal record; decides nothing, the refusal is already made.
Spells the target a pre-dispatch refusal records as the request names it; decides nothing, the refusal is already made.
Picks the id an answer frame carries (none when absent or unreadable); decides nothing.
Says where a signing refusal's decision kind comes from, by the site that refused it; labels the record, decides nothing.
Gives a signing refusal its trace and puts the same trace on its call's untraced grant notes, so Activity lists the call once; decides nothing, the refusal is already made.
Wraps an early stop's ready answer as answered-as-it-stands; a conversion, decides nothing.
